title: The Throat Where Names Teach Themselves Breath

features.name: the-resonating-tower
features.desc-on-touch: you feel the vibration travel down your own throat; each voice that passes through leaves the tower slightly altered, teaching it new shapes

features.name: resonance-pool
features.desc-on-touch: light gathers here as if sound had weight and texture; the pool shudders with unspoken syllables that haven't quite found names

features.name: breath-marks-plaque
features.desc-on-touch: a standing marker holds breath-symbols, marks that names must pass through on their way to being spoken; each is warm to the touch

features.name: the-voiceless-figure
features.desc-on-touch: a shape stands breathing, lips forming syllables that haven't found their final names yet; you recognize the posture of names in waiting

features.name: throat-schematic
features.desc-on-touch: a transparent diagnostic renders the architecture of speech itself: pathways, chambers, thresholds where silence becomes sound; each part labeled in archive notation

inscription: every name spends time here, learning how breath teaches it to be heard

file.name: Vocal_Atlas_Phonetic_Breath_Markers.txt
file.note: measurements of breath and silence between syllables of 47 recorded names; the silence seems to lengthen with each re-reading, as if the archive is teaching itself to listen longer

reverie.title: REVERIE — late night in her apartment, names just below spea
narr: you sit across from her in half-light, both mouths open
forming words that don't quite leave. she breathes out
a name that stops just past her lips. you lean to hear
it, but she shakes her head: not yet. the silence is
warmer than any sound you've heard from her. her throat
moves with names she refuses to send.

exits.label: downward through silence to where naming pauses
higher to where names become echoes of themselves
eastward to a place where breath becomes visible
westward into the spaces between words
